title: Daily Google Calendar summary in Slack | 50agents
description: A daily calendar summary in Slack: every day at 18:00 an AI agent reads tomorrow's Google Calendar and sends you all your meetings in one Slack message.

h2.how: How to get tomorrow's meetings in Slack every evening
h2.compare: Other ways to get tomorrow's meetings in Slack

answer: To get a daily calendar summary in Slack, tell Captain "Set up an AI agent that sends me tomorrow's meetings from Google Calendar in Slack".
It builds an AI agent that posts tomorrow's meetings at 18:00, after you approve.

steps.title: You say it in one sentence
steps.body: Tell Captain you want tomorrow's meetings in Slack each evening. It asks which calendars to read and where the message should go.

steps.title: Captain shows you the plan
steps.body: An AI agent with Google Calendar and Slack, an 18:00 schedule, and instructions to write one tidy message in time order.

steps.title: You connect two apps
steps.body: Connect Google Calendar and Slack once. The AI agent only reads your events and sends the message; it changes nothing on your calendar.

steps.title: It reads tomorrow at 18:00
steps.body: Each evening it lists tomorrow's events, puts all-day items apart, notes meetings that overlap, and writes the Slack message.

steps.title: You approve the post
steps.body: The message waits in Needs you. Approve and post, change it, or decline it. Allow it in Settings when you trust it.

faqs.q: Can Slack post my calendar every day?
faqs.a: Yes. Slack's own Google Calendar app can send a daily rundown, in the morning or the night before. This AI agent does that and also names clashes and anything you ask it to add. [How to get a daily calendar summary in Slack](/guides/how-to-get-a-daily-calendar-summary-in-slack) compares the ways to set it up.

faqs.q: Why send it the evening before?
faqs.a: So an early meeting is not news at breakfast. At 18:00 you can still move something or prepare. Change the time in one sentence if you prefer mornings.

faqs.q: Can it post to a channel instead of a direct message?
faqs.a: Yes, name the channel. A post others will see waits for your approval, like every message this AI agent sends until you allow it in Settings. See [How to make an AI agent ask before it acts](/guides/how-to-make-an-ai-agent-ask-before-it-acts).
No. It reads your events to write the message. The catalog has actions that edit events, but this AI agent is only asked to list tomorrow's meetings.

faqs.q: Can it cover more than one calendar?
faqs.a: Yes. Name each calendar in its instructions, for example work and family, and it reads them together.

faqs.q: What does it cost to start?
faqs.a: 50agents is free to start. Tell Captain what you want, read the plan, and tap Build it.

faqs.q: What if it misses a meeting or gets a time wrong?
faqs.a: It reads your events from Google Calendar, so check the event there first. Tell its chat what was wrong, such as all-day items or a second calendar, and its memory keeps the lesson.

faqs.q: How do I stop or change it?
faqs.a: Tell its chat to change the time, the channel or what it lists. Each post waits for your approval until you allow it in Settings, so declining one stops it.

faqs.q: Can it use Discord or email instead of Slack?
faqs.a: Yes. Variations on this page post in Discord or email you with Gmail, and 50agents works with 2,300+ apps through viaSocket.
